snippet.title: Monsters are Coming! Rock & Road | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Announced during the Future Game Showcase, Monsters are Coming! Rock & Road will release this Autumn!

A demo is now available to check out and play on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3814210/Monsters_are_Coming_Rock__Road_Demo/

WISHLIST ON STEAM - https://store.steampowered.com/app/2934220/Monsters_are_Coming_Rock__Road/
WISHLIST ON GOG  - https://www.gog.com/en/game/monsters_are_coming_rock_road 

Beware, Monsters are Coming! In this Tower-Survivor rogue-lite, you protect an ever-moving city from unrelenting hordes. Gather resources, fortify defenses, and boost potential through enhanced player progression. Will you reach the Arch?  

Fortify: Create your own builds to maximise efficiency by choosing, placing, and upgrading districts through continued run progression. Equip defensive structures to repel monsters from the gates, and keep the city moving forward, else the darkness will consume you!

Forage: Gather wood, stone and gold as a persistent peon who must constantly balance risk vs reward while fighting back endless armies of monsters. Stray from the beaten path to find richer rewards or keep heading due south towards the safety of shelter. 

Fight: Beat Bad Ass Bosses, improve your abilities, overcome environmental obstacles and take charge of special weaponry to continually adapt your strategies. Or see your city turned to ash!

You’re the last hope for humanity, but it’s a long road to the Arch.
